name: SkullGreymon
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card in your hand, until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of your Digimon with the [Demon], [Shaman] or [Titan] trait gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.).
[On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Demon] or [Titan] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
source_effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon is [Titamon] or has the [Titan] trait, it gains ＜Security A. +1}＞ (This Digimon checks 1} additional security cards.).
